paragraphs: While in America, Swamiji pointed his listeners to something they had all seen: the giant Ferris Wheel in Chicago.
As the wheel turns, its little cabins arrive one after another. A group climbs in, rides all the way around, steps out, and a fresh group takes their place.

Swamiji said each of these groups is like a level of life, from the simplest animal to the most evolved human being. Nature is the wheel's endless chain, going round and round without limit. The cabins are the bodies and forms that souls ride in, batch after batch.
And the ride has a direction. The souls keep rising higher and higher, until at last they become perfect and step off the wheel for good.
learn: Wherever you are right now is one stage of a much longer journey, not your final station. Keep climbing; growth is the whole point of the ride.
